items.title: Bristol Myers Squibb (BMY) Gains On Camzyos Data, Is The Upside Already Priced In?
items.summary: Bristol-Myers Squibb (BMY) is back in focus after presenting long term Camzyos data from the EXPLORER-LTE cohort at the 2026 European Society of Cardiology Congress in Munich. Against this backdrop, Bristol-Myers Squibb’s share price has moved to US$66.92, with a 90 day share price return of 22.3% and a year to date share price return of 25.2%, while the 1 year total shareholder return of 47.9% points to stronger gains once dividends are included. items.title: Novartis Reports 3 Patient Deaths. Why the Stock Is Heading for Its Best Day Since 2023.

items.title: This Popular Healthcare ETF Is Diluting Your Dividend Income
items.summary: XLV bundles the entire healthcare sector into one tidy package, but its cap-weighted structure quietly siphons off the income that dividend investors came for. Three stocks already inside the fund tell a very different yield story.

items.title: Novartis, Bristol Myers pause autoimmune CAR-T trials due to safety concerns
items.summary: The deaths of three study participants led Novartis to halt development of rap-cel in multiple indications, while “transient” side effects pushed Bristol Myers to voluntarily pause its zola-cel program.
